items.title: [负面] I would like to recommend this game but im struggl...
items.summary:
I would like to recommend this game but im struggling. Currently getting a thumbs down for unplayability but if they add a server or whatever the problem might be itll change.
CONS: Getting right to the point, my issue is that the game crashes on me ALL THE TIME! I have tried reinstalling, using the fix feature, verifying data and even defragmented my computer. If im lucky i can get to play for an hour but typically its more like 2 minutes after logging in...
PROS: 
- Dark story is a refreshing change of pace
- Meta characters are not the end all be all. Meaning that virtually all the characters could be good if put into the right team and invested in.
Mixed:
- Every character has a mechanic that requires thought to use properly. 
- Difficulty spikes. Getting a high DPS can carry through story, but suddenly the enemy will take half your life with a single attack and you spend all your turn building defense. I like a challenge as much as the next person but if you dont have a maxed out team, prepare to do some grinding..

items.summary:
别的不说我趁沙耶联动入坑买号卖号倒腾几手净赚100。100刚好给最后留下来的号充了。属于是没赚没亏。就这我都能打个四星。
剧情是不看的，副本是不怎么推的，机制玩法是不熟悉的，阵容是只玩一套的。玩了50h我感觉我还是萌新🤣
不过总体而言确实没啥大毛病，玩法、美术、音乐、剧情（我不好说）大致都在我好球区。肝度低、低氪友好。这样就够了呀。
据说游戏最大的雷是制作组。这我倒是不太了解。非洗，这年头哪有不爆雷的制作团队🤣
虽然我不怎么玩了，但请你就这样半死不活地黏住吧，5771！

items.summary: Amazing! I was hooked from just the prologue. Morimens mixes elements of deckbuilder roguelites with HOT ANIME GIRLS (YAYAYYAYAYA) and is super lore rich just as a cherry-on-top. Moreover, the gatcha system is NOT an arduous daily grind (Ikr unheard of) but instead showers the players with lots of free rewards. Overall, strongly recommended.

items.summary:
Awesome game with a small but dedicated team.
Yes, they make mistakes (who doesn't?) but they are very involved with the playerbase and take the time to read through and consider a lot of the suggestions and complaints brought forward by the players. They're trying their best to make a great game work better and it's all I ask for.

If you like card-battlers or roguelites or are even just an inkling of interested in the Lovecraft-inspired story, please give Morimens a try!

BIAV 加油！💪

items.title: [正面] This game is awesome and is the only anime/gacha g...
items.summary:
This game is awesome and is the only anime/gacha game that actually enjoy and plan on playing long term. The game's art is awesome and the character designs are something you wont see in any other gacha or character/hero based game. 

As much as I love the base gameplay and story, I really hope I get to see a world where this game goes 3D or leans heavier into an RPG feel (maybe a separate game entirely). With a world like this, it would be cool to experience it as my character moving through the environment rather than being kept as a chip on a board with the occasionally screenshot with text on it when story happens. Again, love the game for what it is but I think a separate world or game where environment is fleshed out would be really cool

items.title: [正面] 《忘却前夜》是一款克苏鲁风格的卡牌构筑游戏，对我来说是一款爱恨交织的作品，它的美术、角色设计足够抓人...
items.summary:
《忘却前夜》是一款克苏鲁风格的卡牌构筑游戏，对我来说是一款爱恨交织的作品，它的美术、角色设计足够抓人，但复杂的战斗玩法，成为了我入坑最大的门槛。

最让我着迷的，是它独一份的美术画风。厚涂质感的立绘，结合维多利亚暗黑诡谲的克苏鲁氛围，阴郁朦胧的色调，把 “融蚀” 世界那种疯狂又破碎的氛围感完美烘托出来。没有流水线二次元的模板感，每一位唤醒体角色设计都极具辨识度，优雅和异化的细节相互交织，角色档案、CG 插图质量都很高。哪怕暂时打不过关卡，光是翻看角色立绘、阅读人物故事，就足够让人沉浸在这个世界观里。角色群像塑造很有魅力，每个唤醒体背后都藏着痛苦与秘密，我非常愿意去了解他们的过往与命运，光是为了看角色，就愿意继续留在游戏里。

但亮眼的美术之下，玩法部分对卡牌新手并不算友好。作为肉鸽卡牌构筑，游戏拥有庞大的卡牌库、多种体系机制，融合度、狂气、胚胎、力量等一大堆专有词条堆砌在一起，教程讲得很浅，很多机制需要自己反复碰壁才能慢慢摸索明白。战斗时，经常看不懂卡牌联动逻辑，不知道该怎么组牌，明明很喜欢手里的角色，却不知道怎么发挥他们的实力。经常出现看得懂卡牌文字，却搞不懂整套流派该如何运转的情况，打关卡屡屡受挫。

不是玩法不好玩，而是它策略深度很高，更适合熟悉卡牌肉鸽的玩家。对于我这种冲着颜值和人设来的人，战斗会带来很强的挫败感，常常出现：很想看剧情看角色，却被玩法没有看懂而感到烦恼。
